citations.context: Alright, here's the next monster mythical creature we have, the cockatress. This creature is mentioned several times in the King James Version's translations of the books of the prophets. Jeremiah 8 17 says, For behold, I will send serpents, cockatrices among you, which will not be charmed, and they shall bite you, saith the Lord. The Bible critic Jason Long writes in his book, Biblical Nonsense, the prophet Isaiah informs us that a cocketress, a mythical creature able to kill its victim with a casual glance, will arise from a serpent, Isaiah 14 29.
